chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Abbas ibn al-Huraysh al-Razi, on the authority of Abi Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (the second), peace be upon them,

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to Ibn Abbas: 'Indeed, the Night of Power is in every year, and on that night the command of the year descends. For that command, there are leaders after the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family).' Ibn Abbas asked, 'Who are they?' He replied, 'I and eleven from my loins, Imams who are al-Muhaddathun.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the eleven Imams from the progeny of Ali that are considered al-Muhaddathun?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Khisal establishes the theological link between Laylat al-Qadr and the annual revelation of divine decree (amr al-sana), specifically identifying the Twelve Imams as the designated executors of this decree. By using the term 'al-Muhaddathun,' the text emphasizes their unique status as recipients of continuous divine inspiration (wahy ghayr tilawah) following the Prophet, thereby validating their authority as the living embodiment of the year's spiritual and cosmic order.
